title: Irish Kissed Avocado Fried Rice
description: A fusion of Irish and Asian flavors in this unique fried rice dish. Kissed with a hint of Irish charm and topped with crispy avocado.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add cooked Irish kissed rice to the skillet, stirring to combine with onion and garlic.
Push rice mixture to one side of the skillet.
Add remaining 1 tablespoon of avocado oil to the other side of the skillet.
Add diced avocado and cook until crispy.
Flip avocado and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in chopped fried shallots and shredded cheddar cheese.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
